company.shortDescription: MIMOS is Malaysia’s forefront technology provider in Information and Communications Technology, Industrial Electronics Technology.
company.description: MIMOS is Malaysia’s leading technology provider in information and communications technology, industrial electronics technology, and nano-semiconductor technology is MIMOS. As a strategic agency under the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MOSTI), MIMOS contributes to raising Malaysia’s competitiveness by pioneering market creation for Malaysian technopreneurs through patentable technology platforms, products and solutions.
